subjects.title: Introduction to Computing

subjects.description: Covers problem solving, algorithms, and fundamentals of structured programming.

subjects.title: Data Structures and Algorithms
subjects.description: Explores lists, trees, graphs, sorting, and efficient algorithm design.

subjects.title: Web Systems and Technologies
subjects.description: Builds modern web applications with frontend and backend integration concepts.

subjects.description: Introduces classes, inheritance, polymorphism, and object-oriented design.

subjects.title: Automata Theory
subjects.description: Studies finite automata, grammars, and formal language computation models.

subjects.title: Digital Logic Design
subjects.description: Covers number systems, logic gates, and combinational/sequential circuits.

subjects.title: Microprocessors
subjects.description: Introduces processor architecture and low-level programming fundamentals.

subjects.title: Fundamentals of Information Systems
subjects.description: Introduces IT-enabled business processes and information system components.

subjects.title: Purposive Communication
subjects.description: Develops communication skills for academic and professional contexts.

subjects.title: Calculus for Computing
subjects.description: Applies differential and integral calculus to computing-related problems.
